messages:
jordan: Quick sync — compatibility canary for the SDK auth header rename (x-api-key -> x-rw-token). Marketplace + Acme SI need to validate. Proposal: staging canary Tue 10:00-12:00 PT, 1% traffic on marketplace staging, 2 Acme customers in the loop. Need partner signoff, telemetry tags, and a rollback playbook.

anya: Tue ok for eng but support prefers Mon morning (lighter queue). can we target Mon 09:30-11:30 PT instead? :slightly_smiling_face:

leo: tagging telemetry/observability: we need these events from the staging canary: header_mismatch, shim_fallback, auth_error_rate. Can you add the flags so we can graph in Console?

sam: heads-up on marketplace side: staging 1% traffic is fine. we also need the marketplace integration test harness to run against the shimed SDK build. who owns the test run?

maria: marketing check — if this goes well we'll coordinate a short joint note with Acme (no big launch). we need messaging that explains the 6-week grace period and how to roll back.

acme_partner_rep: Acme ok for Mon but can only join the 10:00-11:00 PT block. our SI customers need a clear test plan and a contact for incidents. sending a short doc with the customer list now.

nate: eng-runtime: I can roll the canary and the shim toggle. Plan: 1) deploy shimed proxy image to marketplace-staging, 2) enable 1% routing, 3) smoke tests, 4) open telemetry flag. rollback: immediate toggle off + force-route to v3 proxy.

jordan: Putting action items:
• Finalize window: MON 09:30-11:30 PT but Acme prefers 10:00-11:00 overlap — we’ll do 09:30-11:30 and ask Acme to join 10:00-11:00.
• Nate to deploy shim image and toggle.
• Leo to add telemetry events + dashboard link.
• Sam to run marketplace harness against shim build.
• Maria to draft partner-facing note; keep it descriptive and non-technical.
• Acme to send customer test contacts.

jordan: Quick compat matrix (for the engineers):

```
SDK version | accepted header | shim required
v3.4.x      | x-api-key      | yes
v4.0.0      | x-rw-token     | no
```

leo: I'll add the dashboard. dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/compat-canary-2951236789

sam: test harness owner: @sam-runner (me) — I'll schedule the harness run for Mon 09:40 PT and post results in this thread.

acme_partner_rep: Uploaded customer list + test cases: https://acme.share/test-plan.pdf. We'll have an SI engineer on call for the 10:00-11:00 overlap.

maria: Drafting comms now — will share a short blurb by EOD for legal to review. Keep tone: "graceful header transition, backwards-compatible with shim for 6 weeks."

nate: small ops note: during the canary we'll keep the fallback logs at debug level so we don't flood prod observability indexes. will switch to info on rollback.

jordan: Risk check — what are top 2 failure modes?

leo: 1) Shim misses some edge header parsing -> header_mismatch spike. 2) Marketplace routing misconfiguration -> traffic diversion. Both detectable via dashboard and alerting.

sam: Add automated canary watchdog: if auth_error_rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes, auto-toggle shim off and notify #eng-oncall + partners.

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Compatibility canary for SDK header rename — Mon 09:30 PT. Join marketplace-staging channel for live updates." (will post 60m before start) :bell:

jordan: OK — next steps: Nate deploys and confirms by Mon 08:30 PT, Sam schedules harness, Leo shares dashboard by 17:00 today, Maria shares comms draft by EOD, Acme rep confirms SI on-call. I'll consolidate and ping legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
